seed_rule: SHA256 of split/family/rate/variant/seed; first 8 digest bytes as big-endian Random seed

decision.selection: best calibration macro among challengers whose every family delta vs7 >= -0.01; if none, best macro challenger is diagnostic only and cannot trigger switch; ties prefer smallest log2 distance to7 then fewer days
decision.holdout: one frozen selected challenger vs7 plus the two context controls; no reselection
decision.switch_rule: calibration eligible AND holdout macro delta>=0.01 AND paired trace bootstrap macro lower>0 AND all family simultaneous lower>=-0.01 AND invariant checks pass

limits: Synthetic next-project-visit prediction under identical lexical tiers, not observed user query intent
Every project visit is followed by a return to a neutral directory; the implicit neutral never matches api and is cwd at prediction
No real store, new telemetry, query/selection history or network calls
Disjoint seeds AND generator parameter values between splits; scenario families are shared
Bootstrap intervals describe this fixed synthetic generator, not a human population

execution_details.project_permutation: Random(trace_seed).shuffle([d0,d1,d2,d3]) before event draws; target draw random()
execution_details.event_seconds: day*86400+28800+floor(i*36000/(N-1)), i=0..N-1, N>=2; holiday return day ordinary events use 28860+floor(i*35940/(N-1))
execution_details.holiday_gap: no events on days60..60+gap-1; return day60+gap; evaluation days120 measured from return
execution_details.auxiliary_denominator: ordinary evaluation events with target already recorded; all masks independent of predictions

auxiliary_masks.sparse: all ordinary evaluation events (revisits); report by interval and rate

execution_details.quantile: linear interpolation at index (n-1)*q in sorted replicates
execution_details.holdout_guard: do not generate, read, parity-check or evaluate holdout before frozen selection; production parity uses calibration traces and hand-written edge cases only
